messages.subject: DeSeq R Shiny ReportingTools
parts:
Hello guys I am trying to get R shiny to display reports using reportingTools however even though the reports seems to have been generated the images fail to appear(after waiting for  3 mins for the code to finish running). The whole idea is to get R Shiny to talk to reportingTools and display DeSeq output. reportingTools suggests some codes here to make R shiny work with it. The DeseQ code I am trying to display in R shiny is also listed here on page 3. This is my ui.R and server.R codes below. Anyone knows a better idea on how to get the codes in the DeSeq manual here work well with R Shiny?

library(ReportingTools)
library(shiny)

server.R
library(ReportingTools)
library(shiny)
library(DESeq)



##custom rendering function for server.R
renderRepTools = function(expr, env=parent.frame(), quoted=FALSE) {
  func <- exprToFunction(expr, env, quoted)
  function(){
    paste(capture.output(func()), collapse="\n")
  }
}


##open the report with the shinyHandlers
htmlrep = HTMLReport(reportDirectory = "./",shortName="bigtest", handlers = shinyHandlers)




shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  data(mockRnaSeqData)
  cds<-newCountDataSet(mockRnaSeqData, conditions)
  cds<-estimateSizeFactors(cds)
  cds<-estimateDispersions(cds)
  res<-nbinomTest(cds,"control", "case" )
 
  
  ###use RT to display output
  output$view2 <- renderRepTools({
    publish(res,htmlrep,name="df",countTable=mockRnaSeqData, pvalueCutoff=0.05,conditions=conditions,annotation.db="org.Mm.eg.db",
            expName="deseq",reportDir="./", .modifyDF=makeDESeqDF)
  })
})
